```{r cells}

library(AICcmodavg)

library(ggplot2)

cells <- read.csv('/Users/meganyoumans/Desktop/Adelphi Coursework/Statistical Modeling/Datasets 2/Datasets/Cell_Inhibition_Schoenfeld.csv')

summary(cells)

##Perform model selection
##Inhibitor, Cell Line, VHL status, Concentrations of inhibitor, on Percent Survival 

mod <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Inhibitor)
mod2 <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Inhibitor * cells$Cell.Line)
mod3 <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Inhibitor * cells$VHL)
mod4 <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Inhibitor * cells$Concentration.uM)
mod5 <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Cell.Line)
mod6 <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$VHL)
mod7 <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Concentration.uM)
mod8 <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Inhibitor * cells$Cell.Line * cells$VHL)
mod9 <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Inhibitor * cells$Concentration.uM * cells$Cell.Line)
mod10 <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ cells$Inhibitor * cells$Concentration * cells$VHL)
modint <- lm(cells$PercentSurvival ~ 1)

AICc(mod)
AICc(mod2)
AICc(mod3)
AICc(mod4)
AICc(mod5)
AICc(mod6)
AICc(mod7)
AICc(mod8)
AICc(mod9)
AICc(mod10)
AICc(modint)

##MOD 10 is lowest number for AICc 3897.705

summary(mod10)

summary(modint)
##Residuals:
##    Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
##-65.371 -47.431  -4.231  32.344 290.569 

##Coefficients:
##            Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
##(Intercept)   68.431      2.713   25.23   <2e-16 ***


##Calculate delta AICc - difference between minimum AICc best model, and the current model you're looking at 

AICc(mod) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(mod2) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(mod3) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(mod4) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(mod5) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(mod6) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(mod7) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(mod9) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(mod8) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(mod10) - AICc(mod10)
AICc(modint) - AICc(mod10)

##[1] 238.2
##[1] 236.9157
##[1] 233.6646
##[1] 8.456782
##[1] 248.5579
##[1] 245.5506
##[1] 23.20539
##[1] 6.227913
##[1] 233.392
##[1] 0
##[1] 246.5281


summary(mod10)
plot(mod10)

##Residual standard error: 38.19 on 376 degrees of freedom
##Multiple R-squared:  0.4932,	Adjusted R-squared:  0.4838 
##F-statistic: 52.27 on 7 and 376 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16

##Best models according to delta after model 10 are 8 and 4 to explain the data relationship to the Percent Survival of cells

##I reviewed the models in order of variations from the given data and added predictors randomly. 

##Model 10 has a p value significantly below zero indicating a relationship between the features of cell percent survival relating to inhibitor, concentration and the cell line.
```
